svg.title: Spead AI: data model
svg.desc: sys_client: A customer company (tenant); almost every business table points to it through client_id. sys_user: A person in a company with a division and role, used for sessions and access checks. sys_division / sys_role: Departments and positions; role tags decide which documents a position may read. sys_document: An uploaded knowledge document with approval status and tags. sys_document_chunk: Text chunks of a document with a vector(768) embedding for retrieval. log_conversation: Chat history per user, with embedded chunks so past conversations can be recalled. generated_document: A Document Studio output with its versions in generated_document_version. docstudio_template / docstudio_kop_template: Company templates and letterheads that generated documents must follow. docstudio_document_share / docstudio_comment: Sharing and comments for collaboration on a generated document. connector_koneksi / connector_izin: Connections to external systems and which roles may use them. connector_audit / channel_audit: Audit trail of connector and channel actions. sys_client_token: Token quota per company, enforced before AI work runs.
